label: a1 being kept after an unrewarded rare trial (a1 -> S2, no reward): D1 and the following common S1 at D2
explanation: Low end of candidate unit 5. It is active only when the reward input is 0 (never on rewarded D1 steps), only when the agent is on action a1 (never a2), and almost never at GO. It fires at D1 after an unrewarded trial, when the agent is about to choose a1 again, and again at that trial's D2 if a1 commonly reaches S1. It is strongly tied to the previous trial being a rare a1 -> S2 that went unrewarded, the model-based stay case (prev_common==0 has lift 3.2x and holds 78% of mass; prev_common unknown on a window's first trial is allowed). Its rate falls across the episode and is zero after about trial 80, hence ep_trial<70. Magnitude is largest on these D1/D2 pairs early in the episode when the value head is high (value > 8.1 has lift 3.7x), and when the policy logit favours a1 moderately (2.8 to 8). action is the agent's own upcoming choice (FUTURE at D1, but the agent computes it). An observed-only version that uses prev_action!=2 in place of the D1 action gets dev F1 0.61, against 0.68 for the recorded one. On dev: P 0.59, R 0.81, F1 0.68, mass recall 0.94. Dropping prev_common gives F1 0.43. False positives cluster in low_first episodes and later trials, so the predicate does not fully capture the drift.
